items.statement: The report verifies that the deposited HIAM-234b model is a two-net Co6-bub-bpy crystal and that the comparator retains one complete chemically identical net in the same cell.
items.expected: Explicit CCDC 2478962 identity, net counts 2 and 1, fixed-cell statement, and atom mapping evidence.

items.statement: The two models are treated at comparable fixed-cell solvent-free periodic endpoints and the energy is normalized by net count.
items.expected: Convergence evidence for both models and an explicit per-net normalization equivalent to E(2IP)/2 minus E(NIP)/1.

items.statement: The normalized comparison reports a large stabilization of the observed 2IP framework relative to NIP.
items.expected: A negative 2IP-minus-NIP difference, with magnitude consistent with 188.3 kcal mol−1 per net within the authored tolerance.
